instagram.caption:
The original Pac-Man can't be finished. Level 256 breaks the game.

The level counter only has room for 255. One more and the right half of the screen turns into a mess of letters and symbols.

There aren't enough dots left to clear the level, so the game simply ends there. Players call it the kill screen.

How far did you ever get?
